notes.title: Meet Oleg 'Razor' Korupsky, beloved leader of Radovia!
notes.notes:
This is a portrait of our enlightened and unstoppable leader.
Hail Oleg 'Razor' Korupsky! 🙌

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35235378/6842f05beb716b93c74ef35d0900b252fe233b6e.png[/img]

As a kid, he was the best at parlor game. In high school, he was a master of mumblety-peg. Later, those skills were crucial in his adulthood - he used both skills as a debt collector. It was a watershed moment. He starts and runs a debt collection agency, which was 100% successful. If someone resisted to pay the debt, then, well, one of the game skills was handy. 🔪

It's surprisingly remarkable that someone effective in money collecting could be a party and the whole country leader. Of course, it's all due to hard work. Maybe blood relationships may advance humble party members to strategic positions in Radovia, but that's not about Oleg 'Razor' Korupsky. For sure. Of course, we all remember the great secretary of Radovia, father of the Oleg, but it's not connected on the maintenance nor governance level. 🏛

Today, a few months after embedding in concrete the foundation stone, the nuclear power station is in development. Radovian engineers decided it will be constructed on dry marshlands, on the strong sandstone foundations. At the helm of our invincible leader, Oleg 'Razor' Korupsky, what can go wrong? Nothing, comrade! 🚬

Add the game to your wishlist to learn more about the game and release date announcement. ✅

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1104800/Radiance/

notes.title: Accident is full-released now with a 30% launch discount!
notes.notes:
The time has come - Accident has officially become a full-released game. We have already shared a major update, so if you have Accident it will be transformed into the full-released game and if you don’t have it yet, it is a great opportunity to buy it with a [b]30% launch discount[/b]. We also invite you to join us on a Developers' Stream, which is on our Steam Page.

With the full release update, we give you a whole [b]new scenario[/b] taking place in the Czech Republic, as well as special [b]video cut-scenes[/b] showing the course of each accident, with which all the previous maps have been enriched. They will add a lot of immersion, because now you’ll be able to actually see what happened, instead of imagining it basing on the clues. You will also see how little it takes to bring about a dangerous incident on the road.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/852220

We hope you will enjoy playing and re-playing the new Accident, so we wish you a lot of fun!
